capabilities.title: Privacy-respecting web analytics: sessions, pageviews, events, funnels
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Umami: Google Analytics alternative, cookie-free, self-hosted
capabilities.reason: Nexus is a personal dashboard, not a website analytics platform.

capabilities.title: Next.js + Prisma ORM pattern for production-grade data layer
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Umami: Next.js App Router + Prisma with multi-database support
capabilities.reason: Nexus's single-user local/file stores do not require a multi-database ORM. Adding Prisma and migrations without a relational product requirement would duplicate persistence and enlarge deployment.

capabilities.title: Real-time event ingestion pipeline: high-throughput write path with buffering
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Umami: high-frequency event collection optimized for low latency
capabilities.reason: A single-user dashboard does not need a high-throughput buffered ingestion service. Nexus aggregates bounded local route events synchronously and stores no individual event stream.
